rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-10 SIX-BOX (NEW ARCHITECTURE STAGE: learned-init refiner of the LD-FBP). PREV CHAMPION iter-7 (foe nf24/k7/nb31, 1921p, K=5 tied prox+DC, scalar alpha, 16-ep cosine) hr 0.2515 ssim 0.906 psnr 36.59. DEAD LEVERS: iter-8 SCALED the FoE bank nf24->40 and TOTALLY DIVERGED (psnr 1.87); iter-9 DEEPENED the unroll K5->7 and DIVERGED (psnr 11.38). Both capacity AND depth blow up in 20 min: iter-7 is a SHARP, NARROW stable optimum (K=5, 1921p, 16-ep). FAILURE MODE: with reg-capacity and unroll-depth both exhausted, attack the part that is NEITHER: the INITIALISATION. iter-7 starts the unroll from the raw LD-FBP (psnr ~34.08 floor); the headroom GATE is RMSE-vs-LD-FBP and the unroll is a contraction, so a LOWER-RMSE x_0 maps to a LOWER final RMSE. CHANGE (CODE, +89 params, K=5 KEPT, a real two-stage architecture not a config tweak): ADD a tiny ZERO-INIT learned-init refiner g applied ONCE to the LD-FBP before the unroll: x_0 = clamp(LD-FBP + g(LD-FBP), 0, clip_max). g = 1->8 3x3 conv, ReLU, zero-init 1x1 head (init_channels=8, init_layers=1 => 8*9+8 + 8+1 = 89p). Total = 1921 + 89 = 2010p (<2.2k, <233k ITNet). UNROLL UNCHANGED iter-7 byte-for-byte: reg_type=foe nf24/k7/nb31 (1920p zero-init rho), n_iter=5, single scalar alpha, NO momentum/per-step alpha, plain prox, cosine 5e-3->1e-5, 16 ep, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, bs=1, val_n=214. STABILITY (why it STAYS in the iter-7 basin, unlike iter-8/9): (1) ZERO-INIT head => g=0 at init so x_0==LD-FBP EXACTLY, the seed IS iter-7 byte-for-byte; training only learns a correction (same zero-init-output pattern as CNNReg head / FoE rho). (2) K STAYS 5 -- the unroll dynamics iter-9 destabilised are UNTOUCHED; g is OUTSIDE the loop, applied once, so it cannot interact with the per-step alpha that over-stepped at K=7. (3) the FoE bank STAYS 1920p -- the reg capacity iter-8 destabilised is UNTOUCHED. (4) g is single-scale (NO pooling, dodging iter-2/5 failure), eff RF ~3px -- the smallest learned-init, a local FBP-noise/DC refiner. (5) BUDGET preserved: g is ONE cheap conv pass per forward (NOT per step); per-forward cost is dominated by the 5 DC project pairs, so the 16-ep cosine that fit iter-7 in 1331 s still fits, max_train_s=1080 backstop. HYPOTHESIS: refining x_0 with a tiny zero-init learned filter lowers the RMSE the K=5 contraction starts from -> lower final RMSE (the headroom gate) -> hr ABOVE 0.2515 at +89p, SAME K=5/1921p-unroll. A MATCH ~0.25 maps init-saturation (the unroll drives the init to its fixed point regardless of x_0); a REGRESSION means the refiner learned a destructive correction despite zero-init (diagnosable, revert). PREDICTED hr ~0.25-0.30., reg_type=foe, n_iter=5, learnable_alpha=True, per_step_alpha=False, momentum=False, cnn_channels=12, cnn_layers=3, alpha_init=0.1, clip_max=0.05, epochs=16, cosine_lr=True, cosine_lr_min=1e-05, lr=0.005, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, foe_n_filters=24, foe_kernel=7, foe_n_bumps=31, foe_rbf_init_std=0.0, foe_filter_init_std=0.05, foe_x_range=1.0, learned_init=True, init_channels=8, init_layers=1
